reuse.why: Extends the existing getMonthWideCategories selection used by every month-wide action, but writes its own #fixed regex instead of using extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags.

duplication.why: The rule is added once; the only overlap is a private tag regex that re-implements (with different semantics) the shared tag parser.

placement.why: The exclusion is in the shared month-wide selection in actions.ts, though tag recognition belongs in #shared/tags.

scope.why: Selection change, a focused test and a release note only.

maintainability.why: Centralised and easy to follow; the bespoke regex can drift from how the rest of the app recognises tags.

bypasses_abstraction.where: hasFixedTag in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts uses its own regex instead of extractTagsFromText in packages/loot-core/src/shared/tags.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: hasFixedTag re-expresses tag parsing as a new regex rather than calling the shared extractTagsFromText.

one_place.where: getMonthWideCategories in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending and set3/6/12MonthAvg.
